title: ClassificationDef
description: Definition of an Atlan tag (classification) structure. Atlan tags are governance labels used to classify assets (e.g., PII, Confidential, Deprecated). They are managed via the /api/meta/types/typedefs endpoint. Note: This is different from source-synced tags (SnowflakeTag, DbtTag, etc.) which are entity types representing tags from external systems.

properties.name: category
properties.description: Type category. Always 'CLASSIFICATION' for Atlan tags.

properties.name: guid
properties.description: Globally unique identifier for this tag definition.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Internal hashed-string name of the tag (e.g., 'S7qnUqZ5mBMBpzQ3Wzt6yD'). Use this value when applying tags to assets via the API.

properties.name: displayName
properties.description: Human-readable name displayed in the Atlan UI.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Description of what this tag represents.

properties.name: attributeDefs
properties.description: Optional attributes that can be set when applying this tag to an asset. For example, a 'Sensitivity Level' attribute with allowed values.

properties.name: superTypes
properties.description: Parent classification types (inheritance hierarchy).

properties.name: subTypes
properties.description: Child classification types that inherit from this tag.

properties.name: entityTypes
properties.description: Asset types this tag can be applied to. Empty array means all types.

properties.name: options
properties.description: Visual and behavioral options for the tag including color, iconType (icon/emoji/image), icon (Phosphor icon name), emoji, and imageID.

properties.name: options.color
properties.description: Tag color (e.g., 'Red', 'Green', 'Blue', 'Yellow').

properties.name: options.iconType
properties.description: Type of icon to display: 'icon', 'emoji', or 'image'.

properties.name: options.icon
properties.description: Phosphor icon name when iconType is 'icon' (e.g., 'PhPassword', 'PhRocketLaunch').

properties.name: options.emoji
properties.description: Emoji character when iconType is 'emoji'.

properties.name: options.imageID
properties.description: Uploaded image ID when iconType is 'image'.

properties.name: skipDisplayNameUniquenessCheck
properties.description: Whether to skip uniqueness validation for displayName. Default is false.

properties.name: typeVersion
properties.description: Version of the type definition (e.g., '1.0').

properties.name: version
properties.description: Numeric version counter, incremented on each update.

properties.name: createTime
properties.description: Epoch timestamp (milliseconds) when this tag was created.

properties.name: updateTime
properties.description: Epoch timestamp (milliseconds) when this tag was last updated.

properties.name: createdBy
properties.description: Username or service account that created this tag.

properties.name: updatedBy
properties.description: Username or service account that last updated this tag.
